title: The Jury Methods Package: Synthetic Survey Respondents on Pew ATP Wave 158
description: A public-safe methods package for a 1,000-juror synthetic respondent panel benchmarked against Pew American Trends Panel Wave 158. The artifact documents that probability-vector polling substantially mitigates within-cell variance compression on 10 of 11 questions, while overall validation still fails through topic-specific marginal error (most clearly COVID-19 vaccine refusal and astrology belief). Code is licensed MIT (LICENSE-CODE); documentation and figures are licensed CC-BY-4.0 (LICENSE-DOCS). Raw survey and synthetic row-level data are not redistributed; see DATA_NOT_INCLUDED.md for the reconstruction path.
